title: 第349章 云汐一定满足
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“那个…云汐，我手好像有点麻了。”尽管韩林心里早已把洛云汐当成自己妹妹般看待，但终究不是亲的，这般暧昧的相处，还是让他心里很不自在。

“哦，好吧。”听韩林这么说，洛云汐脸颊微微一红，缓缓地坐了起来。

韩林这才跟着坐起身来，此刻他的神识本源已然修复，识海重新恢复了活力。

整个人精神十足。

见洛云汐埋着头，脸颊微红的坐在床边，他微微一愣后，倒也没有觉得特别的尴尬，就问道：“你，怎么了？”

“我没事。”洛云汐见韩林没有计较昨晚之事，心中的忐忑之情瞬间消失不见，羞涩地一笑道：“韩大哥昨晚睡得好吗？”

“挺好的，神识本源完全修复，消耗的神识也补充了过来，这紫露琼浆的效果确实非同一般！”

韩林说着想到什么，取出昨日洛云汐给的十枚储物戒，“我先看看这里面有没有什么好东西。”

说罢，就开始认真地检查了起来。

当韩林将十枚储物戒全部清点一遍后，心中不禁暗暗惊喜，这里面的好东西确实不少。

其中最让韩林高兴的有三样，一是成熟的凝元草，加在一起足足有两百多株。

虽然通天药园里面的凝元草多达三千多，已经泛滥成灾了，但目前真正成熟可用的，也就两百来株而已。

其次则是赵家之前使用的那套阵旗，四方无门阵。

此阵的威力，他是亲自领教过了，若非他有通天眼，找到了此阵的薄弱之处，并有骨刺这把上品法器相助，恐怕最后，还真有可能被赵秉谦等人生生耗死。

而最后一样东西，则是一根雕着冰晶怪鸟的水晶法杖，一开始韩林并不知晓此杖的用途。

但当他取出来，试验一阵子，并注入水属性真元之后，才终于发现此法杖并不简单。

能够释放出强大的冰霜之力，瞬间冰冻一大片区域。

连洛云汐这种修为一旦被冻住，也感觉浑身冰凉，难以在短时间挣脱出来。

而除了以上三样宝物之外，这些储物戒里面还有各式各样的灵药，妖兽材料，整合在一起相当可观。

唯一的遗憾是，灵石确实不多，即便将所有人加在一起，也才两万多颗下品灵石而已。

可见这些储物戒，多半都是来自赵家的！最近这段时间，赵家的日子真是过得连狗都不如了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Um...Yunxi, my hands seem to be a little numb." Although Han Lin had long regarded Luo Yunxi as his sister, they were not close friends after all. Such an ambiguous relationship still made him feel very uncomfortable.

"Oh, okay." After hearing what Han Lin said, Luo Yunxi's cheeks turned slightly red and she sat up slowly.

Han Lin then sat up. At this moment, the source of his spiritual consciousness had been restored, and the sea of ​​consciousness was revitalized.

The whole person is full of energy.

Seeing Luo Yunxi sitting on the edge of the bed with her head buried and her cheeks slightly red, he was stunned for a moment, but he didn't feel particularly embarrassed and asked, "What's wrong with you?"

"I'm fine." Luo Yunxi saw that Han Lin didn't care about what happened last night, and the uneasiness in her heart disappeared instantly. She smiled shyly and said, "Brother Han, did you sleep well last night?"

"It's very good. The source of spiritual consciousness has been completely restored, and the consumed spiritual consciousness has been replenished. The effect of this purple dew nectar is indeed extraordinary!"

As Han Lin thought of something, he took out the ten storage rings given by Luo Yunxi yesterday, "Let me see if there is anything good in it first."

After that, he started to check it carefully.

When Han Lin counted all ten storage rings, he couldn't help but be secretly surprised. There were indeed a lot of good things in them.

Among them, there are three things that make Han Lin most happy. One is the mature Ning Yuan grass, which totals more than two hundred plants.

Although there are more than 3,000 Ning Yuan grass in Tongtian Medicine Garden, which has become a disaster, but currently there are only about 200 mature and usable plants.

The second is the set of formation flags used by the Zhao family before, the four-way gateless formation.

He had personally experienced the power of this formation. If he hadn't found the weak points of this formation with his clairvoyance, and had the help of the bone spur, a high-grade magic weapon, he might have been consumed by Zhao Bingqian and others in the end.

The last item was a crystal staff carved with a strange ice crystal bird. Han Lin did not know the purpose of this staff at first.

But when he took it out, experimented for a while, and injected water attribute essence, he finally discovered that this staff was not simple.

It can release powerful ice power and freeze a large area instantly.

Even Luo Yunxi's cultivation level would feel cold all over once she was frozen, and it would be difficult to break free in a short time.

In addition to the above three treasures, these storage rings also contain a variety of elixirs and monster materials, which are quite impressive when combined.

The only regret is that there are really not many spiritual stones. Even if everyone is added together, there are only more than 20,000 low-grade spiritual stones.

It can be seen that most of these storage rings come from the Zhao family!During the recent period, the Zhao family's life has been worse than that of a dog.
